Hi Christian,

Thanks for your note, and glad you're looking forward to the BS-4. It's a nice machine: 18 TH/s from four BM1373 chips, around 300 W at the wall, and it comes with the power cord and the Mean Well 350 W supply.

To give you the exact shipping date I need the order number from your confirmation email (it looks like Shop····). If you reply with that, I'll confirm straight away where your unit stands.

The B. ships to you directly from the manufacturer rather than from one of our own warehouses, and the date shown on your order at checkout is the one that holds. A colleague is checking that date against your order today and will come back to you here with it, so you'll have a firm answer either way.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
Sarah

Hi Christian,

I have your order in front of me now, and I am sorry for the worry. Nothing is lost and nothing is wrong: Shop···· was placed on October 20, it is paid in full, and it is going to (address hidden) in Germany.

Your Bitfortun BS-4 ships on October 31. That is the date on your order, so weeks, not months. The Harlo OS Diagnostics plus 3 month RMA cover goes with it. You will get the tracking number by email as soon as the label is made.

The problem on Friday was on our side: our order system was not responding when I tried to open your order, which is why I would not quote you a date I could not see. That has nothing to do with your order itself.

We are a real shop with warehouses in the US, Canada and the Netherlands, and a team you can reach right here in this thread. If anything about the October 31 date changes, I will write to you.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
Sarah

Hi Christian,

Fair question, and the honest answer is yes: I am the team's automated first line of support, and a colleague steps in whenever something needs a person. Your order details above are real, read from your order.

On where it ships from, I do not want to guess. The B. is one of the models that goes out direct from the maker rather than from our own shelves, so your order does not sit in one of our warehouses and I cannot see the ship-from country on it. If it leaves from outside the EU, German import VAT and any duty are charged on delivery by the carrier, since our prices are in USD and we do not collect that at checkout. If it leaves from our Netherlands warehouse, there is nothing extra to pay and no clearance for you to handle.

A colleague confirms which of those two it is for your unit and writes to you in this thread tomorrow from 10am Eastern.

Your ship date of October 31 is unaffected either way.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
Sarah
